en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a rural village surrounded by fields and forest. In the foreground there is a road lined with young trees and a pond or small river with a bridge. Behind it are scattered farmhouses and larger village buildings leading up to a wooded hillside. The printed caption at the bottom left reads "Sommerfrische Grillenburg." The image has the typical white border and composition of an early 20th‑century postcard.
